text:
morgan: Noticed a leak in the Go client during streaming when requests are canceled -> goroutine pileup. Anyone seen this with http2 + conn pool?
raj: yep saw something similar last week on prod. funnel mostly around deadlines + long-lived streams.
sam: Are you using `http.Transport` with ForceAttemptHTTP2 or the low-level golang.org/x/net/http2.Transport?
morgan: ForceAttemptHTTP2 on net/http transport. MaxIdleConnsPerHost=100, IdleConnTimeout=90s. Repro: cancel ctx while streaming, conn not returned.
elaine: Did you call `resp.Body.Close()` in all paths? http2 holds streams until body closed.
morgan: Yes but sometimes goroutine stuck in `io.Copy` when the ctx is canceled => `Read` doesn't unblock.
raj: Try setting `req = req.WithContext(ctx)` before `client.Do(req)` (just in case) and also `Transport.DisableKeepAlives=false`? For http2 we want keepalives but need idle timeout.
sam: Also check `MaxConnsPerHost` vs `MaxIdleConnsPerHost` — if pool exhausted, new conn attempts can block. We should set MaxConnsPerHost to a sane cap.
infra-bot: Reminder: rolling patch for http2 client idle timeout merged to infra last night — might affect behavior. https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/commit/abcd123
morgan: Quick snippet I'm testing: ```go
req = req.WithContext(ctx)
resp, err := client.Do(req)
if err != nil { return err }
// stream to caller
go func(){ io.Copy(w, resp.Body); resp.Body.Close() }()
``` Any glaring issues?
elaine: Wrap copy with select on ctx and explicitly Close on cancel. e.g.: ```go
c := make(chan struct{})
go func(){ io.Copy(...); close(c) }()
select{ case <-ctx.Done(): resp.Body.Close() case <-c: }
```
raj: Also instrument with `GODEBUG=http2debug=2` and `net/http` trace. We saw stream resets logged.
sam: If cancel != closing, http2 might enqueue RST_STREAM but if server ignores it, connection could get stuck. We added a watchdog to CloseIdleConnections for stuck streams.
morgan: Thanks — I can try the CloseIdleConnections watchdog and the select approach. I'll open a PR. pinging @elaine for review.
elaine: sg. If you can add a test that simulates server ignoring RST that'd be ideal. I can review tomorrow. :+1:
morgan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-go/pull/1420 - WIP, notes inside.
ci-bot: CI queued for PR #1420. 1 failing integration test (http2-cancel).
sam: I'll take the integration failing test next, might be flaky. @morgan leave a note on how to repro locally.
morgan: Added repro script + `GODEBUG` instructions in PR. thx everyone.
